variants.text: so remote work has changed things a lot. its not just some small shift. you get flexibility to take care of family and other commitments. companies win because they can pick talent from everywhere and spend less on rent and stuff. but you have problems. communication gets worse, the team doesn't stay stuck together. Also some people get lonely, and the wall between work and home is basically gone. it works or not works. its down to how the company handles expectations, policies, all that stuff.

Working remotely really changed how people do work for good and bad. For folks at home it helps balance work and personal things and the company gets cheap overhead and finds more talent. But there are issues. Communication falls apart if not managed carefully. Cohesion in teams gets worse over time. People feel isolated and mix home and work, not knowing when to stop, or how to start. So it depends on if there are actual policies. But it does need rules and expectations and also to stay human not just digital.
